Every other slot in that 36-word table relocates OUTSIDE 0x0210788c..0x0210a400, so both ends of the run are this class's own code.

NO HOLE: all 40 addresses in 0x0210788c..0x0210a400 have a legacy src/ file and a delinks.txt entry -- `tubuild inspect` reports `functions with no legacy source: none` and `functions without complete: none`. No sourceless member splits the run, so the whole range is claimable as a single .text block.

DESTRUCTOR ORDER IS THE REPRODUCIBLE ONE: the cartridge puts D1 at 0x0210788c BELOW D0 at 0x02107920 and carries no D2. mwccarm 2004/b56 emits D1-then-D0 for an inline in-class destructor, so the pair stays inside the licensed run and this TU promotes whole at 40/40 -- there is no held-out subset. include/dScMgRoulette_c.h's destructor was moved inline for exactly this reason; declared out of line it emits D2/D0/D1 plus a D2 the ROM lacks.

PRAGMA BLOCKER RETIRED BY MEASUREMENT -- AND THE MEASUREMENT CORRECTS MY OWN FIRST READING OF IT. notes/data/tu-promotion-queue.tsv lists this class with pragma:1, and tubuild create's emitted note says optimize_for_size and opt_propagation are FILE-GLOBAL last-wins and refuses to carry them. Four controls, each a full tubuild verify: (a) both shard pragmas bracketed around their own members -> 40/40 MATCH; (b) both pragmas DELETED outright -> 40/40 MATCH; (c) `#pragma optimize_for_size on` at file scope with no closing `off` -> 23/40, 17 DIFF; (d) `#pragma optimize_for_size on`/`off` bracketed around RouletteRacer_CheckLandingB, one of the 17 members control (c) proved to be size-sensitive -> 40/40 MATCH. (c) proves the compile is live and that this pragma really does move bytes; (d) then proves the bracket did NOT bind -- had it bound, 02108d28 would have gone DIFF. The trailing `off` restored the default for the entire file. So mwccarm 2004/b56 IS file-global last-wins for optimize_for_size, notes/agents/roles/writer.md is right, and control (a) proved nothing about positionality: it passed only because control (b) shows both members match at the plain -O4,p defaults anyway. The pragma:1 blocker is therefore a phantom for this class -- the shards' pragmas were belt-and-braces -- and the promoted TU carries no pragma at all. This is a partial retraction of the claim an earlier draft of this manifest made (that brackets bind positionally); the retraction is the measurement, not an opinion.

DEFER_CODEGEN: MEASURED, AND DELIBERATELY NOT USED. Repeating control (d) above with `#pragma defer_codegen off` as the first line of the TU flips the verdict: 39/40 with the DIFF being EXACTLY the bracketed RouletteRacer_CheckLandingB and nothing else. So defer_codegen off does make a positional optimize_for_size bracket bind, which extends the dScMgMemory2_c writer's finding (measured there on opt_propagation and opt_loop_invariants) to a third pragma. It is not used here for two reasons. First, this TU needs no pragma at all -- see control (b). Second, the same run flips emission order: with deferral ON mwcc emits .text in reverse source order, which is why this file is written in DESCENDING ROM order and why `tubuild verify` reports ROM-ascending emission; with `defer_codegen off` the same file reported '38 ordinal pair(s) NOT in ROM order' and linkcheck [4b/8] would refuse it. The two are coupled: adopting defer_codegen off means rewriting the TU in ASCENDING ROM order. Either layout is admissible, but they cannot be mixed.

EXTENT, from two directions. config/arm9/overlays/ov006/relocs.txt carries a relocated word at every address from 0x0213e39c through 0x0213e428 inclusive and nothing again until 0x0213e444, which is the typeinfo header word of _ZTV19dScMgSingle3DBase_c at 0x0213e448 -- so this table is 36 slots, and with the 8-byte header (offset-to-top, plus the 0x0213e398 word that relocates to _ZTI15dScMgRoulette_c at 0x0213e300) its STORAGE runs 0x0213e394..0x0213e42c, 0x98 bytes. mwcc emits a 0x98 section here, which is the same number from the compiler's side. Reading the extent from the next symbols.txt row instead (sSingle3DCommonNcgByLanguage) would have said 0x90 and been wrong low, which is the error notes/agents/roles/writer.md warns about. The _ZTV symbol address is the ADDRESS POINT, not the storage start.
